summary.en: A sweep by rank runs along a chart of unit marks: the others step back to grey, the protagonist swells mark by mark; or a quiet glint in a long hold.
summary.zh: 沿着一张方块图按顺序扫一遍：其余方块退成灰，主角的方块一颗颗胀一下；或者在长停顿里轻轻闪一遍。

fits: The closing second move of a chart scene that ends a film; a glint in a reading hold over 1.5 beats.
notFor: Charts whose marks are not units; a protagonist that has not been named yet.

intent.en: At the end of a chart everything but the protagonist steps back, so the viewer leaves with the one group the film is about.
intent.zh: 图表结尾，除主角外全部退后，观众带走的就是这支片讲的那一组。

content.en: A unit layout already on screen with a protagonist group; nothing new.
content.zh: 屏上已有一张单位图，并已点明主角组；不加新内容。

fits.zh: 结束全片的图表场景的收尾第二动作；超过 1.5 拍的阅读停留里的一次闪光。

notFor.zh: 标记不是单位的图；主角还没点名时。

pairs.note: the closing scene whose beads it lights

en: Use it once, at the end; a sweep in every chapter turns into decoration.
zh: 只在结尾用一次；每章都扫就成了装饰。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
